questions: Should each customer have one set of measurements that you update when they change, or should each order keep its own measurements from the time it was taken?
Can a customer pay more after the deposit (for example, the balance at pickup), and should an order be allowed to be marked collected if it is not fully paid?
Can two customers share the same phone number, or should each phone number belong to only one customer?
answers: No, measurements are kept on the customer.
